subject: Three-dimensional PCA plot with a phylogeny and time on the z-axis

messages.author: 8f308306a17e05c6
messages.subject: Three-dimensional PCA plot with a phylogeny and time on the z-axis
parts:
Hi everyone,
I've really appreciated the vignettes in the recent updates of geomorph! I just noticed the new section "Three-dimensional PCA plot with a phylogeny and time on the z-axis" in the PCA vignette. However, trying to reproduce the plots, I find the tree topologies in the biplot and the rgl 3D plot are inconsistent. The biplot seems to agree with the actual topology (as displayed by plot(plethspecies$phy) ), but the 3D plot is different. Screen shots are attached. Is there an obvious cause for this effect?
Thanks for all your help!
-Dave Angelini

My code is taken from the vignette.
Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethspecies$land, print.progress = F)
PCA.w.phylo <- gm.prcomp(Y.gpa$coords, phy = plethspecies$phy)
plot(PCA.w.phylo, time.plot = TRUE, pch = 22, bg = c(rep("red", 5), rep("green", 4)), cex = 2, 
     phylo.par = list(edge.color = "grey60", edge.width = 1.5, tip.txt.cex = 0.75,
                      node.labels = F, anc.states = F))

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Three-dimensional PCA plot with a phylogeny and time on the z-axis
parts:
Hi Dave,

good to hear the vignettes are helpful!

Yes, the cause of the difference you identified was a bug in the 3D plotting version of the function. I´ve fixed that and it is now updated on both branches of geomorph on github, so please go ahead and install from stable. The vignette has also been updated.

Thanks a lot for picking this up and letting us know!

Antigoni
